title: A Blue Hour for the Aftermath
author: Mirabel Halloran
blurb: Vesper Delacroix, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
